mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM sys_rbac_perm p JOIN sys_rbac_group_perm_rel gpr ON gpr.perm_id = p.id JOIN sys_rbac_perm_group g ON g.id = gpr.group_id AND g.status = #{activeStatus} AND g.delete_time IS NULL JOIN sys_rbac_role_group_rel rgr ON rgr.group_id = g.id JOIN sys_rbac_role r ON r.id = rgr.role_id AND r.status = #{activeStatus} AND r.delete_time IS NULL JOIN sys_rbac_user_role_rel urr ON urr.role_id = r.id WHERE urr.user_id = #{userId} AND p.type = #{menuType} AND p.status = #{activeStatus} AND p.delete_time IS NULL GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id ASC
